capabilities: Browse notes as cards on a homepage
Filter notes with AND/OR/NOT tag logic
Search notes by keyword and date range
Create notes with default locations and randomly browse notes
extras: Detailed user guide and changelog are linked separately from the README; the README covers features and installation but no usage examples.
problem: Obsidian's folder tree offers only one classification method and shows note titles, making it hard to browse notes across multiple tag-based dimensions.
summary: Homepage plugin that displays notes as browsable cards with multi-tag filtering, keyword and date search, and saved filter schemes.
